page.overview:
Who is Drona?

Drona is a Korok who lives in the Forest Haven. Before the Forest Ceremony, Drona can be found flying low to the ground around the base of the Great Deku Tree. After the Forest Ceremony, Drona goes to the Private Oasis to plant new Trees.
